points.quote: **`packages/frontend/`** holds the client code. ... **`packages/backend/`** holds the `server` (NestJS) and `native` ... **`packages/common/`** holds code shared by client and server
**`tests/`** holds the end-to-end and other test suites. **`tools/`** holds the `affine` CLI plus CI and release helpers such as changelog, commitlint and doc-diff.
**`blocksuite/`** is the editor framework the app is built on.
Web app; Mobile web app; Electron desktop app (macOS, Windows and Linux); Android and iOS apps (native shells around the mobile build); Admin dashboard
`native` and `mobile-native` hold Rust bindings. ... **`packages/backend/`** holds the `server` (NestJS) and `native` (Rust, via napi).
It's the backend for self-hosted and cloud AFFiNE.
PostgreSQL, accessed through Prisma. ... Redis, used for caching, the socket.io adapter and queues. ... a GraphQL API (`schema.gql`)
